expressions.title: The Embodiment (Pakistan National Guard) (Validation) Act, 1951
expressions.title_basis: p1 block 1643527 prints 'ACT No. XXI OF 1951 An Act to validate the embodiment of certain units of the Pakistan National Guard ...'; s.1 names it; it runs to s.3 'Indemnity' on p2. The p1 head (ss.2-4 amending the Code of Criminal Procedure, the tail of an earlier Act) is a fragment, and ACT No. XXII OF 1951 (East Bengal (Smuggling of Foodgrains) (Amendment) Act, 1951) runs to the foot of p2, the last page, with no signature -- it may continue beyond this copy, so it is set aside rather than created incomplete (owner policy q1 'split').

expressions.title: The Post Office (Amendment) Act, 1951
expressions.title_basis: p1 block 1643517 prints 'ACT No. XX OF 1951 An Act further to amend the Post Office Act, 1898'; s.1 names it the Post Office (Amendment) Act, 1951; complete ss.1-2; not held elsewhere in the corpus.
